title: MZ A few small questions in one

posts.author: MHDevBlue
posts.body:
1 - How would I go about adding sound effects for when the text box opens and closes, as well as pressing the A button to advance to the next text box?
2 - Is there a way to show a small pop-up when you get an item that tells you what it is, that doesn't pause the gameplay to tell you in a big text box?
3 - How can I allow characters to turn in place with a quick press of the arrow button, rather than immediately moving?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Turn in place:
https://casper-gaming.itch.io/cgmz-player-movement
The sound effects could simply be evented. Simply place a sound effect directly before and after your message command. I'm not sure how you differentiate between moving to the next box by hitting A and simply playing the sound for the next box, so maybe elaborate on that, otherwise to me it seems like the same thing. Hitting A to dismiss the current box will immediately play the sound effect you put after it, so it's effectively the same thing as having a dedicated "A button sound".

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
To add to SG's reply, I pretty much recommend that method as this is how I did it in my own game.
In this case, I would just add a "UI_messageProgress.ogg" sfx after each message.
However, at a later point I realized this is a bit of a mistake as it's not very easily scalable.
Say for example in the future you decide you want to change the sound, either to a new file or maybe change the volume.
Now you'd need to go back through every single event and change each individual sound.
Instead, it would be better to put the sound into a common event, and then run the common event at the end of each message box. That way if you need to modify the sound in the future, it's as simple as editing the common event.
